why_they_differ: The first --execute run built the provenance commit with commit-tree under the ambient identity and clock, so its hash was a function of when it ran. publish_lineage.sh now pins the author, committer and date to values the frozen record already fixes ($REV's committer date), which makes the commit re-derivable as 3bcdeb3e on any machine. The already-published ref was NOT rewritten to match: replacing it needs a force-push onto a branch whose whole purpose is to refuse one. The identity #47 turns on is the TREE, and both commits carry the same tree, so the published ref satisfies the requirement while the determinism fix applies to any future publication.
